shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- agent files ---'; find . -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---'; sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- lib/db.js ---'; sed -n '1,240p' lib/db.js; printf '%s\\n' '--- layout ---'; sed -n '1,180p' app/layout.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs matches ---'; rg -l \"revalidateTag|updateTag|cacheTag|use cache\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- next config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- cacheTag ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- revalidateTag ---'; sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- caching guide ---'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- server actions relevant ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"inline|form action|revalidateTag\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md; printf '\\n--- use cache ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md; printf '\\n--- cache components config ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md; printf '\\n--- inline server action ---\\n'; rg -n -C 12 \"inline Server|inline.*action|function.*'use server'|'use server'\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md | sed -n '1,180p'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- root agent ---\\n'; cat AGENTS.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: next.config.ts @@ -const nextConfig: NextConfig = {} - -nextConfig.cacheComponents = true +const nextConfig: NextConfig = { + cacheComponents: true, +} *** Update File: app/page.tsx @@ - SKU-{String(product.id).padStart(4, '0')} + + SKU-{String(product.id).padStart(4, '0')} + *** Update File: tsconfig.json @@ - \"lib\": [ - \"dom\", - \"dom.iterable\", - \"esnext\" - ], + \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"], @@ - \"paths\": { - \"@/*\": [ - \"./*\" - ] - } + \"paths\": { + \"@/*\": [\"./*\"] + } }, - \"include\": [ - \"next-env.d.ts\", - \"**/*.ts\", - \"**/*.tsx\", - \".next/types/**/*.ts\", - \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\" - ], - \"exclude\": [ - \"node_modules\" - ] + \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"], + \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"] } *** End Patch PATCH git diff --check nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,130p' printf '\\n'; nl -ba next.config.ts; printf '\\n'; nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"
